messages:
Maya (docs): FYI PR #4672 ready for final review. Migration guide + SDK snippets included. Preview shows two issues: a linkcheck 404 and one runtime behavior question blocking wording about request.timeouts. Preview: https://ci.redwood.example/preview/4672

CI-bot: docs preview completed: 2 checks failed (linkcheck, lint). Link failure: docs/migration/auth.md -> 404. Lint: markdown style error in docs/migration/timeout.md line 12.

Maya (docs): The reviewer comment: 'Ambiguous: what happens if request.timeout is omitted in client calls? docs currently say "inherits route defaults" but we need concrete numbers for hosted/dedicated/private.' Can runtime confirm?

Jeff (runtime): Short answer: hosted default = 30s. Dedicated: omission means "no explicit server-enforced timeout" (worker-level behavior; often longer or provider-specific). Private (on-prem): follows local operator config. Streaming: idle heartbeat closes after 90s by default. Please add a clear table in the guide.

Sam (sdk): Implementation note: our Python SDK maps omission and None differently. Omission -> server default; timeout=None -> client disables SDK timeout (which currently raises validation on Dedicated). JS maps undefined -> server default, null -> sent as null. We should doc the mapping and advise users to omit the field rather than set null.

Lin (eng): Confirming: Dedicated API rejects explicit null for timeout with a 400 validation error. I'll open a tiny API-spec PR to make the error message clearer. Docs should say: "Do not set timeout: null; omit to use runtime default."

Maya (docs): I'll change the migration doc to include a three-column table (hosted/dedicated/private) and three SDK snippets (py/js) showing omission vs explicit values. Also will fix the broken auth.md link to point to docs/security/token-rotation.md.

Jeff (runtime): Also add one-line: if routing policy selects a fallback model, the selected model's route timeout is the one applied (timeout evaluated post-routing).

Sam (sdk): I'll update the example snippets in the PR and add a tiny unit test that asserts our mapping behavior (omit => server default, undefined/None => client mapping).

Maya (docs): Marking PR blocked until I push fixes and the CI re-runs. I'll push in ~15m. @Jeff please confirm when the runtime note is landed in the API spec.

CI-bot: re-run queued by Maya (docs). Preview #802 pending.

Maya (docs): Thanks team — pushing fixes now. :pray:
